career_ladder.note: Engineer Trainees in Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) undergo 1 year of training on starting basic pay of ₹50,000 in Grade E-1 (₹50,000–₹1,60,000). Upon successful completion of training, they are regularized as Engineer in Grade E-1 on basic pay of ₹60,000 (scale ₹60,000–₹1,80,000) and progress through executive management cadres across manufacturing divisions (Bhopal, Haridwar, Trichy, Hyderabad, etc.) following BHEL Merit Promotion Scheme and DPC norms.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Engineer Trainees in BHEL is conducted through a standalone Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Personal Interview. Shortlisting for interview is carried out in a 1:3 ratio based on CBT score. Final merit is prepared by assigning 75% weightage to the Computer Based Test (CBT) and 25% weightage to the Personal Interview.

financial_package.note: Compensation is governed by DPE 3rd Pay Revision Committee (PRC) guidelines for Maharatna CPSEs. During the one-year training period, Engineer Trainees receive starting basic pay of ₹50,000 in Grade E-1 (scale ₹50,000–₹1,60,000). On regular absorption as Engineer in Grade E-1, basic pay is fixed at ₹60,000 (scale ₹60,000–₹1,80,000). Includes mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, cafeteria approach allowances @ 31% to 35% of basic pay, HRA (9% to 27%) or BHEL township accommodation, performance-related pay (PRP), and medical benefits. Approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) is ₹14 Lakhs during training and ₹17.50 Lakhs on absorption.
financial_package.pay_level: IDA Grade E-1 Trainee (₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000) / Regular Engineer (₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000)
financial_package.pay_source_label: BHEL ET Terms of Appointment & Emoluments Notification
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹50,000 during training, 58% IDA (₹29,000), Cafeteria perks @ 35% (₹17,500), and HRA (9% to 27% = ₹4,500 to ₹13,500), less statutory deductions for PF (12% of Basic + DA = ₹9,480), Gratuity, Superannuation, and income tax. Post-absorption in E-1 (Basic ₹60,000), gross pay increases to ₹1,18,000 – ₹1,38,000 per month.

Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach up to 35% of Basic Pay

Performance Related Pay (PRP) linked to company profitability and individual performance
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Defined Contribution Pension Scheme
Free medical attendance and hospitalization benefits for employee and dependent family members in BHEL hospitals
Uniform allowance, safety gear allowance, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
